explanation: atlas.ts reads each contributing study card into named AtlasDataset fields (publication and an http(s)-only link, technology, cells or nuclei, sampled region, sex, age stage, condition, cells in HypoMap), blank as null; byDataset rows still carry only id, label and metrics. The gated By dataset view shows those fields on each checked dataset card, and the by-dataset CSV appends Publication and Technology columns. Co-detection still reads only the wire labels.
